reasoning_trace: Witness monitor independently flagged validation-enrichment DOWN then RECOVERED, with zero foreknowledge of the injected fault. validation-enrichment's own logs show it was healthy and actively validating at the start of the window (2 payments cleanly validated), then failed its health check, then came back up via a full application restart roughly 22 seconds later (fresh Tomcat init, HikariPool reconnect, MongoDB reconnect). In that gap, of 34 submitted payments only 2 reached PAYMENT_VALIDATED -- everything else stalled at or before validation. Same funnel-stall + independent-witness shape as prior rounds' NETWORK_LATENCY cases. Conclusion reached from evidence alone, before reading the injector's own log: validation-enrichment.
confirmation_basis: Blind conclusion (validation-enrichment) matches the injector's own ground-truth log exactly. Consistent with three prior NETWORK_LATENCY replications, all attributing the same root service via the same witness+funnel-stall evidentiary pattern.
